description_en: Compares two face images by using face recognition technology and returns the comparison result and a similarity score
description_zh: 通过人脸识别技术，可以对传入的两张人脸图片进行比对验证，返回人脸对比结果和相似度分值
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl face-compare-v2 --merchant-biz-id e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c353888 --source-face-picture base64 --source-face-picture-url https://000face1.jpeg --source-face-picture-file InputStream --target-face-picture base64 --target-face-picture-url https://000face2.jpeg --target-face-picture-file InputStream --face-picture-quality-check N --face-quality-check Y --region cn-hangzhou
name: FaceCompareV2

parameters.help_en: The merchant-defined unique business ID used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can be a combination of letters and numbers with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长 32 位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded source face image.

> **Note**

- If you use this method to pass in the image, check the image size and do not pass in an excessively large image.
- Specify one of the following parameters: SourceFacePicture, SourceFacePictureUrl, or SourceFacePictureFile
